notes:
おたま is the common everyday word for a ladle used to serve soup, stew, and other liquid dishes. The full formal name is お⟦{玉杓子|たまじゃくし}→玉杓子：noentry⟧, shortened to おたま in daily use.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- おたま⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦よそう→よそう：noentry⟧ (to serve/dish out with a ladle)
- おたま⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{掬|すく}う→掬う：noentry⟧ (to scoop with a ladle)
- おたま⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦かき{混→かき{混：noentry⟧|ま}ぜる (to stir with a ladle)

ETYMOLOGY:
おたまじゃくし also means 'tadpole' because of the similar shape — a round head on a long handle. The kitchen utensil likely got its name from this resemblance.
